      public void setSize(int width, int height)
      Set the minimum size of the world. If the size of the window is changed, the world will adapt to fit the minimum number of latitudes and longitudes regardless of how small it is made.
      Parameters:
      width - minimum width of the world
      height - minimum height of the world
